item.message: Code Mode is unavailable because code-mode host is disabled. Code mode will fail closed; enable `features.code_mode_host` and install `codex-code-mode-host`.

item.text: {"rule":"The procedure appears to preserve ace of hearts: if it is among the first two tapped, those remain; otherwise they are discarded. In the final pair, it remains if tapped and the other card remains if not, so ace of hearts is always final."}
